token_provenance.accent: omp.sh --accent light theme oklch(44% .18 348) (deep rose, the brand primary)
token_provenance.hairline: warm light rule derived to read on the cream canvas
token_provenance.method: brand_extract.py returned insufficient signal (SPA); tokens hand-mined from omp.sh/assets/index-Cxvog3cH.css custom properties and converted oklch->sRGB. Assisted-native path per routine Step 6.3.

secondary_palette.note: oh-my-pi's own dark-theme surface + neon accents, used for inset code/terminal panels and the duel win/corrupt states on the light frame

readability.canvas_polarity: light (canvas luma ~235; build_html light path auto-engages: dark ink, accent-ink deepened toward ~60, dark code panels)
readability.ink_floor: primary ink #191926 luma ~26 (<=60 light floor); bold display carries p0.7 with -webkit-text-stroke
readability.accent_as_text: deep rose #920864 (luma ~44) reads dark-on-cream at ~8:1; used for hash/anchor marks and one accent word per beat
readability.solid_dark_coverage: every scene carries a dark code panel or a bold dark headline so the light-canvas readability gate has real dark coverage (crawl4ai lesson: never thin dark text on cream)
readability.inverted_beat: the dark code panels ARE the inverted (dark-field) beats on a light canvas; the split money shot flips polarity per pane
readability.brightness_plan: light canvas => bright by construction; >=30% bright trivially satisfied; >=2 temperature beats (warm paper / cool cyan IDE panels / warm rose lock)
